content.text: {"core": "Transformation closes what has finished so the next thing has room. In Faith — holding steady inside uncertainty — it ends the portions of a commitment that have already done their work. When it barely operates, finished portions stay gripped. Dead weight fills the waiting, and the vigil stiffens into carrying something already over.", "sheetLine": "The vigil is still gripping what already ended; the hold stiffens into dead weight."}
